items.title: Trump says U.S. communities opposing AI data centers could end up 'backwards and poor'
items.summary: "China could not be happier with this anti Data Center movement," Trump said as Republicans express concerns about the backlash to data centers.
items.titleZh: 特朗普表示，反对人工智能数据中心的美国社区最终可能会“落后和贫穷”
items.summaryZh: “中国对这场反数据中心运动感到非常高兴，”特朗普说，共和党人对数据中心的反弹表示担忧。

items.title: Workers want more money than ever to risk taking a new job
items.summary: Workers are hesitant to leave their roles as AI and layoffs reshape the labor market. They need more money to jump ship.
items.titleZh: 工人们比以往任何时候都想要更多的钱来冒险接受一份新工作
items.summaryZh: 随着人工智能和裁员重塑劳动力市场，工人们对离职犹豫不决。他们需要更多的钱来擅自离船；跳槽。

items.title: Broadcom reports earnings this week. Mike Khouw says this trade could be a winner
items.summary: "The stakes are high" heading into Broadcom earnings, says Mike Khouw.
items.titleZh: 博通本周公布收益。Mike Khouw表示，这笔交易可能会成为赢家
items.summaryZh: Mike Khouw表示，博通盈利的“风险很高”。

items.title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
items.summary: The singer, 21, will be now represented by a public defender in the murder trial of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. He has pleaded not guilty.
items.titleZh: 美国歌手D4vd的名人律师退出谋杀案
items.summaryZh: 这位21岁的歌手现在将在14岁的塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯的谋杀案审判中由一名公设辩护人代理。他不认罪。

items.title: Tesla FSD can soon avoid potholes, says Elon Musk who said exactly that in 2019
items.summary:
The ability to avoid potholes while on FSD is “coming soon,” according to an update posted by Tesla CEO Elon Musk over the weekend. It would be great news for Tesla drivers, if we hadn’t heard that exact same thing before.



 more…
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克在2019年曾说过，特斯拉FSD很快就能避开坑洼
items.summaryZh: 根据特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克周末发布的最新消息，在FSD上避免坑洼的能力“很快就会到来”。如果我们以前没有听到过完全相同的事情，这对特斯拉司机来说将是个好消息。

items.title: Trump says data centers are a 'golden goose' and communities will end up 'poor' without them
items.summary: President Donald Trump said that communities that oppose data centers "want to end up being backwards and poor."
items.titleZh: 特朗普表示，数据中心是一只“金鹅”，没有数据中心，社区最终将变得“贫穷”
items.summaryZh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，反对数据中心的社区“希望最终落后和贫穷”

items.title: X’s AI tool Grok now allows users to buy or lend crypto with MoonPay integration
items.summary: The new tool also lets users move beyond crypto, with services such as restaurant reservations and flight bookings.
items.titleZh: X的人工智能工具Grok现在允许用户通过MoonPay集成购买或借出加密货币
items.summaryZh: 新工具还允许用户超越加密货币，提供餐厅预订和航班预订等服务。

items.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
items.summary: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.
items.titleZh: Clipto使用人工智能搜索数TB的视频，目前价值2.5亿美元
items.summaryZh: 这家成立三年的初创公司表示，在筹集最新一轮1500万美元之前，其ARR和盈利能力已达到1500万美元。

Rivian CFO Claire McDonough is stepping down effective October 30, leaving after nearly six years to become chief financial officer of energy giant GE Vernova.



The departure lands at the most important moment in Rivian’s history — the ramp of the R2, the $…

items.title: South Korea Will Give Every Citizen Free AI Access With Unlimited Tokens
items.summary: Three consortia will run the service, sharing up to 512 Nvidia B200 chips supplied by the state, with beta testing due in September.
